dict.string: Visage hears the sound of your AI app to play it back in sync with the face it animates. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

With the microphone option, Visage reads how loud your voice is while your AI listens to you, so that the face nods at your pauses and thinks once you have finished. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
With the camera option, Visage finds where your face is so that its gaze follows you and its head gains depth. Images are read on your Mac, never recorded or sent anywhere.
